findings.description: The motion of the hand brushing against the face and hair is created by rapidly looping the same few frames forward and backward (a 'boomerang' effect). This violates the forward flow of time and creates unnatural repeated beats.

A rapid, continuous scratching/clicking sound effect plays throughout the video, but the frequency and timing of the sound do not match the visual strokes of the object against the man's face or hair. There is no visible cause for the continuous sound.
